About MIRAKLE

India's most trusted name in light — for architects, furniture makers and the homes they create.

Who we are

MIRAKLE is the lighting brand of Hrisha Lighting Projects LLP, Ahmedabad. It brings three kinds of light under one name: specification lighting for architecture, a solder-free system for modular furniture, and decorative pieces for the rooms in between.

How we work

COB spotlights are made to order, with no minimum quantity. The lead time is confirmed with the order. Layout and fitting selection is done with the architect, ideally before the ceiling is closed.

What we publish

Key values are nominal, with a typical tolerance of ±10%. LED flux and efficacy are the LED maker's declared values where so marked. We publish what we can stand behind, and nothing else.
